text:
Vera Li: Quick flag 1: onboarding quickstart (vite + cf worker) broken after last package.json exports refactor. New users see: 'Failed to resolve module specifier "@redwood/inference"' in browser dev console.

Tom H.: I can repro locally with wrangler + vite. Our exports only define import/require for the package root and no types or browser/default fallback. Some bundlers/edge resolvers ignore the import conditional and fail.

Ivy Martinez: Also seeing editor noise: TS can't find the types because we removed top-level "types" in the cleanup. VSCode shows "Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/inference'". That's a major DX hit for onboarding.

Vera Li: Sample-apps workaround was a deep import: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference/dist/esm/index.mjs'` which is ugly but works. We shouldn't ask users to do that.

Priya Nair: Looks like auth/retry helpers are missing from the ESM entry in dist. Some sample code imports `auth.wrapRetry` and fails at runtime because it isn't exported. Rollup marked the auth util external in the ESM build.

Tom H.: Proposal: Publish a patch that adds top-level fields and explicit subpaths. Minimal package.json changes: set "types": "dist/index.d.ts", add "main" and "module" fallbacks, and extend exports to include types/default plus explicit helper subpaths (./auth, ./retry) that point to dist artifacts. Example snippet: "exports": { ".": { "types": "./dist/index.d.ts", "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "default": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" }, "./auth": { "import": "./dist/esm/auth.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/auth.cjs" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" }.

Ivy Martinez: For types we should also ensure d.ts is emitted next to esm build and add top-level "types" key. Maybe add a typesVersions map for ESM vs CJS consumers.

Priya Nair: For the immediate onboarding pain: I'll add a note to quickstart README instructing a temporary Vite alias and deep-import fallback while we ship the patch. Also add a CI smoke that runs vite+wrangler.

build-bot: CI #899 sample-apps/onboard-quickstart FAILED. Excerpt: `Error: Could not resolve '@redwood/inference' (vite)
 at resolver.resolve (/virtual/loader.js:...)` Link: internal.

Tom H.: I'll open a small PR for v0.14.5 that updates package.json exports + types + module/main fallbacks. Priya, can you open a follow-up for rollup changes to include auth/retry in the esm bundle or emit separate helper artifacts?

Vera Li: Sounds good. Thanks everyone 64f. Please ping here when PRs are up so onboarding metrics don't regress further.
